correctness.rationale: For boundary parameters u,v, tangential ball inclusion is equivalent to r≥q||A(u-v)||²/||u-v||². Unit secant directions fill the open u-hemisphere, whose Rayleigh supremum for A² equals \(a^2\). Equality and secondary contacts occur exactly in its top eigenspace; the local curvature term is the tangent-plane Rayleigh maximum. The proof covers all dimensions, multiplicities, round bodies, nonattainment of a second contact, and the unbounded pointwise curvature gap. Reproduced verify.py: 2023 exact-rational spot checks, not a proof by enumeration.

value.rationale: The pointwise least-radius profile for prescribed normal tangency is a natural geometric input to variable-radius ball support. Its all-dimensional exact spectral formula classifies all remote sharp contacts and distinguishes global geometric containment from pointwise curvature, with arbitrarily large ratio at major-axis tips. This is a complete structural boundary/contact classification, unlike a routine substitution of the known global threshold. The claim explicitly excludes the older global constant as novel.
